items.title: Wounded Hridoy finds his heart
items.summary: Hercules was celebrated for immense strength, yet his story was defined by a tragic cycle of destructive impulse, lapse of judgment, and severe physical trial. His vulnerabilities gave his triumphs weight. Hridoy’s Mirpur outing suffered from similar rashness -- impatient, eager to force the pace before establishing a baseline.
